basis: Peroxisomal disorder with neurologic and retinal degeneration; liver dysfunction common (>30%); sensorineural hearing loss also common, omitted at four-axis cap.
Pontocerebellar hypoplasia and neuropathy; kyphoscoliosis in 2/2 patients. Cerebral visual impairment does not establish intrinsic eye damage.
Prenatal alcohol exposure causes defining, persistent neurodevelopmental and cognitive impairment; other organ malformations are not universal across this spectrum.
Benign eccrine duct tumour arising in vulvar dermis; its tissue of origin is skin.
Bone fragility and craniosynostosis define disease; communicating hydrocephalus in 2/2 and dentinogenesis imperfecta in 1/2. Proptosis alone does not establish eye damage.
Defining intellectual disability and axonal neuropathy; persistent musculoskeletal abnormalities include kyphoscoliosis in 4/9 and distal amyotrophy in 7/9.
Idiopathic impairment of gastric emptying defines a stomach motility disorder.
Inherited photosensitive blistering disease with cutaneous scarring; an infectious or systemic lymphoproliferative mechanism is not established for this familial concept.
TMPRSS3-related nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; no defining extra-auditory disease.
Sulfatide storage causes central and peripheral demyelination; optic atrophy occurs in 30-79%. Cholecystitis and hearing loss are under 30%; incontinence is neurologic.
Ependymal tumour originates in the frontal lobe of the brain.
Acute pathological colonic dilatation with severe dysfunction; infectious and inflammatory underlying causes vary and are separate diagnoses.
Spastic paraplegia with neuropathy; pes cavus in 5/8 and skeletal muscle atrophy in 30-79%. Bladder abnormalities are under 30%.
Progressive spastic paraplegia and axonal neuropathy define disease; cardiomyopathy, arrhythmia and diabetes occur in only 5-29%.
Developmental impairment, cataract and deafness define syndrome; cleft palate/oligodontia occur in 30-79%. Frequent joint and limb abnormalities omitted at cap.
Umbrella of inherited galactose/fructose metabolic disorders; hepatic, ocular and neurologic injury vary substantially between subtypes.
Occlusive disease of pulmonary veins and capillaries causes pulmonary hypertension and impaired pulmonary function.
Viral infection defined by its cutaneous eruption; skin is the defining site despite the usually transient course.
Brainstem dysfunction, deafness and gaze palsy define syndrome; carotid malformations are major features and heart defects common. Central hypoventilation is neurologic.
Intellectual disability and microcephaly define disease; optic neuropathy in 2/6 (~33%) supports ocular involvement. Minor skeletal findings lack established functional damage.
Defined disruption of amino acid metabolism; no shared organ injury beyond the metabolic mechanism is established for this umbrella.
Chronic immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease with persistent pruritic nodules; associated hepatic, renal and systemic diseases are separate diagnoses.
Developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with hypomyelination; hypoglutaminemia in 2/8 and low CSF glutamine in 2/7 do not establish a common systemic metabolic phenotype.
Metaphyseal dysplasia, intellectual disability and conductive deafness define syndrome; ocular findings occur in only 5-29%. Recurrent otitis does not imply immunodeficiency.
Personality disorder without defining structural or functional damage to any of the 13 organ axes.
